text: No-go for a raw Double kernel-view SPI in stable core. CanonicalArray/MutableCanonicalArray are the validated minimal safe prototype: zero-wrapper monomorphic linear access without raw storage. JVM arrays and JS Float64Arrays cannot be lent safely because callbacks can retain them; immutable mutation and exclusive-mutable aliasing cannot be prevented, and borrowed inputs have external writers. Any future raw capability must live in a separate explicitly unsafe platform-specific experimental artifact. Evidence: CanonicalAccessSuite 7/7 JVM and 7/7 JS; docsCheck passed.
